title: Pope Leo to end Argentina tour with outdoor mass before Peru 'homecoming'
summary: Pope Leo will conclude his three-day visit to Argentina Wednesday with an outdoor mass expected to draw millions before continuing his tour of South America by travelling to Peru, where he once served as a missionary.
